```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  memory-mcp-ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          activate-environment: "memory-mcp"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd memory-mcp
          uv pip install -e .

      - name: Lint with ruff
        run: |
          cd memory-mcp
          uv run ruff check .

      - name: Test with pytest
        run: |
          cd memory-mcp
          uv run pytest -v

  wifi-cam-mcp-ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          activate-environment: "wifi-cam-mcp"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd wifi-cam-mcp
          uv pip install -e .

      - name: Lint with ruff
        run: |
          cd wifi-cam-mcp
          uv run ruff check .
```
